ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: weighted_advantage_margin_logsigmoid_normalized_symmetric_clipping_loss
ir.intuition: Inject an explicit normalization constraint by normalizing the advantage_gap vector per sample with z-score before applying symmetric clipping to ensure scale invariance and stable margin scaling, improving robustness.
ir.pseudocode:
norm_per_sample = norm(advantage_gap)
zscore_adv = (advantage_gap - mean(advantage_gap)) / max(std(advantage_gap), epsilon)
symmetric_margin = clamp(zscore_adv, -1, 1)
norm = max(mean(norm_per_sample), epsilon)
x = alpha * scale * (log_prob_w - log_prob_l) / norm
x = x - mean(symmetric_margin)
x = clamp(x, -20, 20)
loss = -logsigmoid(x)
loss = loss * weight
return sum(loss) / sum(weight)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch['weight']
    advantage_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))
    scale = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('scale', 1.5))
    epsilon = 1e-6
    norm_per_sample = ops.norm(advantage_gap)
    mean_norm = ops.mean(norm_per_sample)
    norm_adv_gap = ops.maximum(mean_norm, epsilon)
    zscore_adv = ops.zscore(advantage_gap)
    symmetric_margin = ops.clamp(zscore_adv, -1.0, 1.0)
    margin_mean = ops.mean(symmetric_margin)
    x = ops.mul(alpha * scale, ops.div(ops.sub(lpw, lpl), norm_adv_gap))
    x = ops.sub(x, margin_mean)
    x = ops.clamp(x, -20.0, 20.0)
    loss = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(x))
    loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)
    weighted_sum = ops.sum(loss)
    weight_sum = ops.sum(weight)
    loss_scaled = ops.div(weighted_sum, ops.maximum(weight_sum, epsilon))
    return loss_scaled
